chunks: Verily We showed Moses the way, and bequeathed the Book to the children of Israel,
ai.seo_question: What did God give to Moses and the Children of Israel according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the distinct yet complementary roles of prophetic intuition and revealed scripture, with Moses representing the pinnacle of direct divine guidance and the Israelites embodying the custodianship of the Law. This duality reflects the broader theological framework where the Imam serves as the living embodiment of both the inner meaning (batin) and the outer law (zahir) of revelation. The verse thus establishes the Israelites' historical privilege while hinting at the need for continued interpretation of the Book through the lineage of prophets.
